doc: 2026-10-10, Jeff's lock from the variant sheets: toes X3 (the hallux 30 mm wide and set 4.5 mm apart, toe 2 slimmed to 16, the lesser toes of variant E curled 25 degrees, the fifth 32) and heel H1. 2026-10-14, the shape pass (Jeff: 'from the top it looks too long and too round'; spec 01 §3.1 note): the midfoot and forefoot amounts refitted for the plan outline (fit_sculpt.py --only mid_widen,mid_fill,fore_w,lat_mid_in,med_mid_in,head5_out,mid_lat_up,fore_lat_up,fore_low_fill,arch_drop,dorsum_50,dorsum_60,dorsum_70), the heel and the toes held. 'sculpt' are pass A's amounts (fit_sculpt.py; the heel's and toe2_w set by the variant sheets), 'fixed' pass B's operations over fields.FIXED, 'targets' the MPFB foot targets S1 loads. 2026-10-15, shape pass 2 (Jeff: 'I think toe 2 looks right; it is the big toe that is too long'; critic series foot_shape round 1; spec 01 §0, §3.1, §3.3 notes): the hallux shortened 1.5 mm in its proximal phalanx and 6 in its distal segment (hallux_short_mm; the foot 282 -> 274.7), the lesser toes' knuckles lowered, toe 5 rolled 55 degrees (right 50), turned 10 in and curled 38 / 14, the heel tapered above its pad (heel_taper) and the front of the ankle's fillet tightened at the crease (ankle_front); the fitted amounts held. 2026-10-16, the scan-driven pass (Jeff: drive the large forms from real geometry; spec 01 §0, §3.1, §3.3, §3.5 notes): the scan bases (pb_*, hb_*, sb_*) and the heel's width fields fitted to three men's foot scans' sections (scanfit.py, scan_targets.json; fit_sculpt.py --only scan_bases,heel_..., then the forefoot's for the ball girth), toes 2-5 refitted to the scans' cascade and girths, the heel taper's narrowing off (pct and low_pct 0), the lesser toes' DIPs straight (toe 5 6 degrees).
